```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library("data.table")
library(reshape2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(svglite)

# modules
source("background-colours.R")

# functions

source("utils.R")
source("utils/dataInputClass.R")
source("utils/plotClass.R")

# global variables
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

load("tmp/mainData.Rda")
load("data/zeroBlasts.Rda")
load("tmp/metaData.Rda")
load("tmp/imageClickData.Rda")
```

```{r scatterplot_all}
progPlotData <- new(Class = "progressionPlotClass", blastData = blastData)
progPlotData@bead_weight <- 0.03
progPlotData@colours_prog <- c("yellow", "blue", "red")
progPlotData@hideUnchanged <- "hide_unchanged"
progPlotData@run <- c(3)
progPlotData@blast_count <- c(0,1,2,3,6,10)
progPlotData@blast_duration <- c(0.1)
progPlotData@moving <- c(T,F)
progPlotData@row_val <- c(1,2,3)
progPlotData@col_val <- c(1,2,3)
progPlotData@list.group <- as.list(c("blast_count", "move_val", "colour"))
progPlotData <- selectData(progPlotData)
progPlotData@simBlast <- simulateBlasts(progPlotData)
progSummary <- summariseData(progPlotData)

dat <- progSummary@progSummary
dat <- dat %>% mutate(num.of.beads.shown = ifelse(blast_count == 0, 0, num.of.beads.shown))
categories <- unique(unlist(dat["move_val"]))
fullSet <- unlist(dat["move_val"])
dat$shape_val <- NA
counter <- 0
print(categories)
for(cat in categories){
  counter <- counter + 1
  dat$shape_val[fullSet == cat] <- as.character(cat)
}
  
dat <- dat %>% mutate(colour_val = ifelse(colour == "yellow", "#FFF37D", ifelse(colour == "red", "#EE36BB", ifelse(colour == "blue", "#46ADC3", "#FFFFFF"))))
dat <- dat %>% mutate(plot.id = paste0(colour_val, shape_val))

    
    p <- ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = blast_count, y = num.of.beads.shown, group = plot.id, shape = shape_val)) +
      geom_point( color = dat$colour_val, size = 2)
    
    p <- p + theme_classic()
    p


  ggsave(filename = "~/Documents/imogen-geology/svg/blast_count-number_of_beads.svg", plot = p, device = "svg", , width = 160, height = 80, units = "mm")
    
```

```{r scatterplot_optimal_scaled_depth}
progPlotData <- new(Class = "progressionPlotClass", blastData = blastData)
progPlotData@bead_weight <- 0.03
progPlotData@colours_prog <- c("yellow", "blue", "red")
progPlotData@hideUnchanged <- "hide_unchanged"
progPlotData@run <- c(3)
progPlotData@blast_count <- c(0,1,2,3,6,10)
progPlotData@blast_duration <- c(0.1)
progPlotData@moving <- c(F)
progPlotData@row_val <- c(1,2,3)
progPlotData@col_val <- c(1,2,3)
progPlotData@list.group <- as.list(c("blast_count", "blast_duration", "run", "colour"))
progPlotData <- selectData(progPlotData)
progPlotData@simBlast <- simulateBlasts(progPlotData)
progSummary <- summariseData(progPlotData)

dat <- progSummary@progSummary
dat <- dat %>% mutate(num.of.beads.shown = ifelse(blast_count == 0, 0, num.of.beads.shown))
categories <- unique(unlist(dat["run"]))
fullSet <- unlist(dat["run"])
dat$shape_val <- NA
counter <- 0
print(categories)
for(cat in categories){
  counter <- counter + 1
  dat$shape_val[fullSet == cat] <- as.character(cat)
}
  
dat <- dat %>% mutate(colour_val = ifelse(colour == "yellow", "#FFF37D", ifelse(colour == "red", "#EE36BB", ifelse(colour == "blue", "#46ADC3", "#FFFFFF"))))
dat <- dat %>% mutate(plot.id = paste0(colour_val, shape_val))

    
    p <- ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = blast_count, y = num.of.beads.shown, group = plot.id, shape = shape_val)) +
      geom_point( color = dat$colour_val, size = 2)
    
    p <- p + theme_classic()
    p


  ggsave(filename = "~/Documents/imogen-geology/svg/blast_count-number_of_beads_optimal_scaled_depth_discrete_blast.svg", plot = p, device = "svg", , width = 160, height = 80, units = "mm")
```

```{r barplots_discrete_bottom}

barPlotData <- new(Class = "allBarPlotsClass", blastData = blastData)
barPlotData@moving <- c(F)
barPlotData@stack_colours <- T
barPlotData@blast_duration <- c(0.1)
barPlotData@blast_count <- c(1,2,3,6,10,20)
barPlotData@run <- c(3)
barPlotData@combine_replicates <- T
barPlotData <- selectData(barPlotData)
barPlotData <- generatePlot(barPlotData)

p <- barPlotData@p[[1]]

p
```
